name: quiz

title: Flashcards
description: CSS 3-D flip-card deck with optional self-rating (Again / Hard / Good / Easy) and a session summary.

title: Match
description: Click-to-match term/definition pairs with mistake tracking and animated wrong-answer shake.

name: fill-blank
title: Fill in the Blank
description: Inline blank-filling exercise supporting multiple blanks per sentence, alternative accepted answers and keyboard navigation.

name: scramble
title: Word Scramble
description: Letter-tile word unscrambling game with optional image/text clues and a reset button.

name: order
title: Order / Sequence
description: Drag-and-drop (or ↑↓ keyboard) item-sequencing exercise that reveals the correct order on failure.

title: Reading Passage
description: Three-phase reading comprehension: passage view → inline questions → results. Supports plain text or HTML and optional passage-hiding.

title: Progress Tracker

title: Image Hotspot
